test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, what is still tricky about resuming travel?

options.text: What to do in the long quarantine
What will be open when they reach the destination
Which travel agency to choose for bookings
Which mode of transport is safest

solution:
The correct answer is **"What will be open when they reach the destination."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look at the second sentence of the first paragraph:
 
 
• *"Figuring out where they can go and what will be open when they get there remain tricky—for both would-be tourists and travel companies."*
 
 
 
• The passage mentions that travellers may face uncertainty regarding what will be open at their destination.
 
• This can make planning and booking travel more difficult.
 
• The situation is still evolving as countries and regions continue to adjust their COVID-19 restrictions.
 
• It's important for travellers to stay informed and flexible in their plans. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "What to do in the long quarantine" **is not mentioned in the passage as a tricky aspect of resuming travel.
 
• **Option 3: "Which travel agency to choose for bookings"** is not mentioned as a specific challenge in the passage, although travelers may want to consider working with a reputable agency to navigate the complexities of travel during the pandemic.
 
• **Option 4: "Which mode of transport is safest"** is not specifically mentioned as a tricky aspect of resuming travel in the passage, although the author notes that some travellers may prefer certain modes of transport over others for personal comfort or safety reasons.
